content:
Platforms: Windows, Public Cloud
This event provides key metadata regarding security groups in AWS. CrowdStrike retrieves this information by processing the response from AWS's
DescribeSecurityGroups API [https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeSecurityGroups.html] on your behalf. Each event
represents a specific rule/ACL defined within a security group and are associated based on the AwsGroupId field.
Rules represent the actual logic or ACL applied to the group.
This event is only generated for Discover for AWS customers. It's generated either when Discover for AWS observes new or related activity via CloudTrail or
during Discover for AWS's weekly full scan.
